96		var actions := {"move_left": [KEY_A, KEY_LEFT], "move_right": [KEY_D, KEY_RIGHT], "jump": [KEY_SPACE], "pause": [KEY_ESCAPE, KEY_P], "restart": [KEY_R], "confirm": [KEY_ENTER], "menu": [KEY_M], "water": [KEY_W], "mute_music": [KEY_N], "mute_sfx": [KEY_B]}

106	func _add_solid(rect: Rect2) -> void:
107		var body := StaticBody2D.new()
108		body.position = rect.position + rect.size / 2
109		body.collision_layer = 1
110		body.collision_mask = 2
111		var shape := RectangleShape2D.new()
112		shape.size = rect.size
113		var collision := CollisionShape2D.new()
114		collision.shape = shape
115		body.add_child(collision)
116		add_child(body)

118	func _add_area(rect: Rect2, layer: int, spikes: bool) -> Area2D:
119		var area := Area2D.new()
120		area.position = rect.position
121		area.collision_layer = layer
122		area.collision_mask = 2
123		if spikes:
124			# Three exact triangular trigger silhouettes; no oversized invisible box.
125			for i in range(3):
126				var triangle := CollisionPolygon2D.new()
127				var x := float(i) * rect.size.x / 3.0
128				triangle.polygon = PackedVector2Array([Vector2(x, rect.size.y), Vector2(x + 4, 0), Vector2(x + 8, rect.size.y)])
129				area.add_child(triangle)
130		else:
131			var collision := CollisionShape2D.new()
132			var shape := RectangleShape2D.new()
133			shape.size = rect.size
134			collision.shape = shape
135			collision.position = rect.size / 2.0
136			area.add_child(collision)
137		add_child(area)
138		return area

141		if state == State.PLAYING:

146	func restart_attempt() -> void:
147		state = State.PLAYING
148		elapsed = 0.0
149		retry_remaining = 0.0
150		# Area2D overlaps are physics-step snapshots. Discard pre-teleport contacts
151		# until the broadphase has observed the reset, preventing a phantom second death.
152		contact_settle_ticks = 2
153		player.reset_at(Vector2(level.spawn[0], level.spawn[1]))
154		player.enabled = true

158		saved_popup_ticks = 0

162		flights.clear()

167	# Blocking-fire height in px: full until hosing starts, then shrinks linearly to 0
168	# over EXTINGUISH_TICKS (half by 2 s). Drives both the flame visual and the kill-zone.
169	func fire_height() -> float:
170		if not fire_active or not level.has("blocking_fire"):
171			return 0.0
172		var full: float = float(level.blocking_fire[3])
173		if extinguish_ticks > 0:
174			return full * float(extinguish_ticks) / float(EXTINGUISH_TICKS)
175		return full

177	func set_paused(value: bool) -> void:
178		if value and state == State.PLAYING:
179			state = State.PAUSED
180			player.enabled = false
181		elif not value and state == State.PAUSED:
182			state = State.PLAYING
183			player.enabled = true

185			player.jump_request_tick = -1000

191	func resolve_contacts(fatal: bool, finished: bool) -> void:
192		if state != State.PLAYING:
193			return
194		if fatal:
195			state = State.DYING
196			deaths += 1
197			retry_remaining = 0.55
198			player.enabled = false
199			player.velocity = Vector2.ZERO
200			if death_reason == "The fire got you.":
201				player.show_pose("burned")
202				play_sfx("burn")
203				retry_remaining = FIRE_DEATH_HOLD  # burned pose + DEVASTATED pop-up stay up; R skips the wait
204		elif finished:
205			state = State.COMPLETE
206			last_finish_time = elapsed
207			player.enabled = false
208			player.velocity = Vector2.ZERO
209			player.show_pose("celebrate")
210			complete_ticks = 0
211			play_sfx("win")

213	func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
214		if state == State.DYING:
215			retry_remaining -= delta
216			if retry_remaining <= 0:
217				restart_attempt()
218		elif state == State.PLAYING:
219			elapsed += delta
220			var fell := player.position.y > float(level.fall_y)
221			var timed_out := elapsed >= float(level.time_limit)
222			var hit_fire := false
223			for hazard in hazard_areas:
224				if hazard.overlaps_body(player):
225					hit_fire = true
226			# The blocking fire is lethal + blocks the path until FULLY hosed. Its kill-zone
227			# shrinks from the top with the flames (see fire_height), but the base stays lethal
228			# until the fire is completely out -- so walking in mid-extinguish still kills.
229			if fire_active and level.has("blocking_fire"):
230				var bf0: Array = level.blocking_fire
231				var fire_top: float = (float(bf0[1]) + float(bf0[3])) - fire_height()
232				var half_w: float = Player.BOX.x / 2.0
233				if player.position.x + half_w > float(bf0[0]) and player.position.x - half_w < float(bf0[0]) + float(bf0[2]) and player.position.y > fire_top and player.position.y - Player.BOX.y < float(bf0[1]) + float(bf0[3]):
234					hit_fire = true
235			var fatal := fell or timed_out or hit_fire
236			if fatal:
237				death_reason = "Out of time!" if timed_out else ("You fell." if fell else "The fire got you.")
238			# Hose: tap W within range of the blocking fire -> water pours ~4 s -> fire out.
239			near_fire = false
240			if fire_active and level.has("blocking_fire"):
241				var bf: Array = level.blocking_fire
242				near_fire = player.is_on_floor() and player.position.x > float(bf[0]) - 50.0 and player.position.x < float(bf[0]) + float(bf[2]) + 10.0 and player.position.y < float(bf[1]) + float(bf[3]) + 20.0 and player.position.y > float(bf[1]) - 40.0
243				var water: bool = player.test_water_pressed if player.test_control else Input.is_action_just_pressed("water")
244				if player.test_control:
245					player.test_water_pressed = false
246				if water and near_fire and extinguish_ticks == 0:
247					extinguish_ticks = EXTINGUISH_TICKS
248					water_ticks = EXTINGUISH_TICKS + 60  # water lingers ~1 s after it is out
249					play_sfx("hose")
250			if extinguish_ticks > 0:
251				extinguish_ticks -= 1
252				if extinguish_ticks == 0:
253					fire_active = false
254			if water_ticks > 0:
255				water_ticks -= 1
256			player.hosing = water_ticks > 0
257			# Touch to rescue -- only while NOT in a fatal state, so you can't rescue THROUGH fire.
258			if not fatal:
259				for s in survivors:
260					if not s.rescued and s.area.overlaps_body(player):
261						s.rescued = true
262						s.area.set_deferred("monitoring", false)
263						rescued_count += 1
264						player.rescued = rescued_count
265						player.bag_types.append(s.type)
266						player.bag_in_flight += 1
267						player.play_actions([["grab", GRAB_TICKS], ["toss", TOSS_UP_TICKS]])
268						flights.append({"type": s.type, "from": Vector2(s.x, s.y), "t": 0})
269						play_sfx("rescue")
270						saved_popup_ticks = 55
271						saved_popup_pos = Vector2(s.x - 18.0, s.y - 34.0)
272			var all_rescued := rescued_count >= survivors.size()
273			var at_exit := goal.overlaps_body(player) and player.is_on_floor()
274			if at_exit and not all_rescued:
275				locked_cue_ticks = 45  # flash "rescue everyone first"
276			if locked_cue_ticks > 0:
277				locked_cue_ticks -= 1
278			if saved_popup_ticks > 0:
279				saved_popup_ticks -= 1
280			if contact_settle_ticks > 0:
281				contact_settle_ticks -= 1
282			else:
283				# Exit completes only when BOTH survivors are rescued AND reached on foot.
284				# State machine unchanged; only the COMPLETE condition gains "both rescued".
285				resolve_contacts(fatal, at_exit and all_rescued)
286			camera.position.x = clampf(player.position.x + 100, 320, float(level.width) - 320)
287		if state == State.COMPLETE:
288			complete_ticks += 1
289		for fl in flights:
290			fl.t += 1
291			if fl.t == GRAB_TICKS:  # toss starts: launch from his raised hand, straight up
292				fl.launch = player.position + Vector2(0.0, -62.0)
293				fl.apex = fl.launch + Vector2(0.0, -TOSS_HEIGHT)
294			if fl.t >= GRAB_TICKS + TOSS_UP_TICKS + TOSS_DOWN_TICKS:
295				player.bag_in_flight = maxi(player.bag_in_flight - 1, 0)
296				player.queue_redraw()
297		flights = flights.filter(func(fl): return fl.t < GRAB_TICKS + TOSS_UP_TICKS + TOSS_DOWN_TICKS)
298		if is_instance_valid(hud):
299			hud.queue_redraw()
300		queue_redraw()  # refresh the level's own dynamic draw: survivors vanish, SAVED! animates, exit unlocks

302	func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
303		if event is InputEventKey and event.echo:
304			return
305		if event.is_action_pressed("mute_music"):
306			_toggle_mute("Music")
307		elif event.is_action_pressed("mute_sfx"):
308			_toggle_mute("SFX")
309		elif event.is_action_pressed("confirm"):
310			if state in [State.MENU, State.COMPLETE]:
311				start_session()
312			elif state == State.PAUSED:
313				set_paused(false)
314		elif event.is_action_pressed("pause"):
315			set_paused(state != State.PAUSED)
316		elif event.is_action_pressed("restart") and state in [State.PLAYING, State.PAUSED, State.DYING]:
317			restart_attempt()
318		elif event.is_action_pressed("menu") and state in [State.PAUSED, State.COMPLETE]:
319			state = State.MENU
320			player.enabled = false
321		elif event is InputEventMouseButton and event.pressed and event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT:
322			if Rect2(220, 215, 200, 34).has_point(hud.get_local_mouse_position()):
323				if state in [State.MENU, State.COMPLETE]:
324					start_session()
325				elif state == State.PAUSED:
326					set_paused(false)

328	func _draw() -> void:
329		if level.is_empty():
330			return
331		var font := ThemeDB.fallback_font
332		var ink := Color("25354a")
333		# All visual assets are original Godot vector drawing, not recovered art.
334		# The A1 cream sky, grid, and hills are replaced by the generated ENV-BG (see _ready).
335		# Burning buildings — decorative facades drawn BEHIND the ledges (no collision).
336		for b in level.get("buildings", []):
337			var bl := Rect2(b[0], b[1], b[2], b[3])
338			draw_rect(bl, Color("e0cdaf"))                                         # very light brown wall (contrast for dark figures)
339			draw_rect(Rect2(bl.position, Vector2(bl.size.x, 5)), Color("a3855f"))  # roof cap (medium brown)
340			draw_rect(bl, Color(0.96, 0.46, 0.16, 0.18))                           # warm fire glow (keeps the burning read)
341			for wx in range(int(bl.position.x) + 18, int(bl.end.x) - 14, 84):
342				for wy in range(int(bl.position.y) + 16, int(bl.end.y) - 24, 34):
343					draw_rect(Rect2(wx, wy, 13, 17), Color("6f5c46"))
344					draw_rect(Rect2(wx + 2, wy + 2, 9, 13), Color("f2ecd8"))
345		for entry in level.solids:
346			var r := Rect2(entry[0], entry[1], entry[2], entry[3])
347			# Light concrete with a dark outline: the A1 navy (#25354a) vanished against ENV-BG's dark fog (#2c3547).
348			draw_rect(Rect2(r.position - Vector2(1, 1), r.size + Vector2(2, 2)), Color("1b2230"))
349			draw_rect(r, Color("b8b2a6"))
350			draw_rect(Rect2(r.position, Vector2(r.size.x, 4)), Color("438e7d"))
351			for x in range(int(r.position.x)+12, int(r.end.x), 24):
352				draw_line(Vector2(x, r.position.y+12), Vector2(x+7, r.position.y+19), Color("8f897d"), 1)
353		# Fire hazard drawn as bold flames, data-driven from the hazard rect. The VISUAL is
354		# enlarged for readability but the COLLISION (the rect, built in _add_area) is
355		# UNCHANGED, so the jump-over margins verified by flame-clearance-positive still
356		# hold. Flame tips stay below the player's jump clearance, so a cleared jump does
357		# not clip the visual.
358		# ENV-FIRE (generated flames) drawn over each hazard rect: the wide street fire uses the wide
359		# cluster, small ones a row of single flames. Visual only: the COLLISION is the rect built in
360		# _add_area, unchanged, so the flame-clearance tests still hold. The art reaches ~8 px above the
361		# rect, like A1's code-drawn tips, so it can look touched without killing (forgiving).
362		for entry in level.hazards:
363			var hr := Rect2(entry[0], entry[1], entry[2], entry[3])
364			var vis := Rect2(hr.position.x - 2.0, hr.position.y - 8.0, hr.size.x + 4.0, hr.size.y + 8.0)
365			if hr.size.x >= 40.0:
366				draw_texture_rect(FIRE_WIDE, vis, false)
367			else:
368				var n: int = maxi(1, int(round(vis.size.x / (vis.size.y * 0.55))))
369				for k in range(n):
370					draw_texture_rect(FIRE_SINGLE, Rect2(vis.position.x + vis.size.x * k / n, vis.position.y, vis.size.x / n, vis.size.y), false)
371		# Finish: a FIRE-ESCAPE window. Data-driven from level.finish; LOCKED until both
372		# survivors are rescued, then it brightens with a "JUMP OUT" prompt.
373		var fr := Rect2(level.finish[0], level.finish[1], level.finish[2], level.finish[3])
374		var all_saved := rescued_count >= survivors.size()
375		var glow := Color("e8792b") if all_saved else Color("6b7683")
376		var pane := Color("ffe08a") if all_saved else Color("aeb7c2")
377		draw_rect(Rect2(fr.position.x - 3.0, fr.position.y - 3.0, fr.size.x + 6.0, fr.size.y + 6.0), glow)
378		draw_rect(fr, ink)
379		draw_rect(Rect2(fr.position.x + 2.0, fr.position.y + 2.0, fr.size.x - 4.0, fr.size.y - 4.0), pane)
380		draw_rect(Rect2(fr.position.x + fr.size.x / 2.0 - 1.0, fr.position.y + 2.0, 2.0, fr.size.y - 4.0), ink)
381		draw_rect(Rect2(fr.position.x + 2.0, fr.position.y + fr.size.y / 2.0 - 1.0, fr.size.x - 4.0, 2.0), ink)
382		draw_rect(Rect2(fr.position.x - 2.0, fr.end.y - 2.0, fr.size.x + 4.0, 3.0), ink)
383		if all_saved:
384			_label(Vector2(fr.position.x - 22.0, fr.position.y - 14.0), "JUMP OUT →", 13, Color("7fe0b0"))
385		else:
386			var lx: float = fr.position.x + fr.size.x / 2.0
387			var ly: float = fr.position.y + fr.size.y / 2.0
388			draw_rect(Rect2(lx - 4.0, ly - 1.0, 8.0, 7.0), Color("3a2f1a"))
389			draw_arc(Vector2(lx, ly - 1.0), 3.0, PI, TAU, 8, Color("3a2f1a"), 1.5)
390			_label(Vector2(fr.position.x - 40.0, fr.position.y - 14.0), "FIRE ESCAPE", 13, Color("f6f3ec"))
391		if locked_cue_ticks > 0:
392			_label(Vector2(fr.position.x - 66.0, fr.position.y - 30.0), "Rescue everyone first!", 14, Color("ff7a66"))
393		# "SAVED!" popup that rises + fades at the moment of a rescue.
394		if saved_popup_ticks > 0:
395			var pa: float = clampf(float(saved_popup_ticks) / 55.0, 0.0, 1.0)
396			var rise: float = float(55 - saved_popup_ticks) * 0.35
397			_label(saved_popup_pos - Vector2(0.0, rise), "SAVED!", 16, Color(0.5, 0.88, 0.69, pa))
398		# Trapped survivors (un-rescued only), each with a HELP! bubble to draw the player in.
399		for s in survivors:
400			if s.rescued:
401				continue
402			var sx: float = s.x

var bag_types: Array = []  # survivor types riding in the bag, e.g. ["person","dog"] (set by session)
var jumps: int = 0
var test_control: bool = false
var test_axis: float = 0.0
var test_jump_pressed: bool = false
var test_jump_held: bool = false
var test_water_pressed: bool = false  # hose input hook for the scripted route / tests
# Extinguisho art: one static generated image per state, swapped in (visual only; never read by gameplay).
const ART_DIR := "res://art/character/"
const BOX := Vector2(20, 40)   # collision box; feet at the origin (CHARACTER-SHEET, collision option A)
const LAND_TICKS := 20         # landing pose holds this long after real air time (was 8: too fast to see)
const NOZZLE := Vector2(33, -27.5)  # hose nozzle tip in the hose pose (game px, facing right): the water starts here
# Rescue bag center per pose (game px, facing right): on his back at the hip, measured on each image.
const BAG := {"idle": Vector2(-10, -30), "respawn": Vector2(-13, -20), "run": Vector2(-8, -21),
	"jump_crouch": Vector2(-9, -30), "rising": Vector2(-10, -18), "falling": Vector2(-12, -16),
	"landing": Vector2(-8, -20), "hose": Vector2(-10, -19), "grab": Vector2(-10, -27),
	"toss": Vector2(-10, -31), "burned": Vector2(-10, -30), "celebrate": Vector2(-9, -27)}
var pose: String = "idle"
var art: Node2D
var sprite: Sprite2D
var textures := {}
var anchors := {}
var jumped_this_air: bool = false
var air_ticks: int = 0
var land_ticks: int = 0
var was_on_floor: bool = true
var hosing: bool = false        # water is pouring (set by session)
var bag_in_flight: int = 0      # survivors still flying toward the bag (set by session); their heads appear on landing
var action_queue: Array = []    # timed poses that override movement, e.g. [["grab", 15], ["toss", 27]]
var action_cancel_on_move: bool = false

func _ready() -> void:
	name = "Player"
	collision_layer = 2
	collision_mask = 1
	floor_snap_length = 1.0
	var shape := RectangleShape2D.new()
	shape.size = BOX
	var collider := CollisionShape2D.new()
	collider.shape = shape
	collider.position = Vector2(0, -BOX.y / 2.0)
	add_child(collider)
	var info: Dictionary = JSON.parse_string(FileAccess.get_file_as_string(ART_DIR + "anchors.json"))
	anchors = info.anchors
	for state in anchors:
		textures[state] = load(ART_DIR + state + ".png")
	art = Node2D.new()
	art.show_behind_parent = true  # the code-drawn rescue bag stays on top of the art
	add_child(art)
	sprite = Sprite2D.new()
	sprite.centered = false
	art.add_child(sprite)
	show_pose("idle")
	add_child(HoseGlow.new())  # visual only; the driver reads `hosing` and writes the shader's `glow`
	add_child(JumpPuffDriver.new())  # visual only; the driver reads `landed` and adds a JumpPuff to the level node

# Swap the state image. The anchor (bottom-center of the collision box in texture px)
# lands on the origin; the holder's negative x scale mirrors the art when facing left.
func show_pose(state: String) -> void:
	pose = state
	sprite.texture = textures[state]
	var a: Array = anchors[state]
	sprite.position = -Vector2(a[0], a[1])
	art.scale = Vector2(0.5 * facing, 0.5)
	queue_redraw()  # the bag follows the pose

# Timed state poses (grab, toss, respawn), played in order and held for their tick count.
func play_actions(steps: Array, cancel_on_move: bool = false) -> void:
	action_queue = steps.duplicate(true)
	action_cancel_on_move = cancel_on_move
	show_pose(action_queue[0][0])

func _update_pose() -> void:
	var on_floor := is_on_floor()
	if on_floor:
		if not was_on_floor and air_ticks > 10:
			land_ticks = LAND_TICKS
			landed.emit()
		air_ticks = 0
		jumped_this_air = false
	else:
		air_ticks += 1
	was_on_floor = on_floor
	if land_ticks > 0:
		land_ticks -= 1
	if not action_queue.is_empty() and action_cancel_on_move and (absf(velocity.x) > 8.0 or not on_floor):
		action_queue.clear()
	if not action_queue.is_empty():
		show_pose(action_queue[0][0])
		action_queue[0][1] -= 1
		if action_queue[0][1] <= 0:
			action_queue.pop_front()
	elif not on_floor:
		# A jump is one flying kick all the way; walking off a ledge is the meditating fall.
		show_pose("rising" if jumped_this_air else "falling")
	elif land_ticks > 0:
		show_pose("landing")
	elif absf(velocity.x) > 8.0:
		show_pose("run")
	elif hosing:
		show_pose("hose")
	else:
		show_pose("idle")

func reset_at(spawn: Vector2) -> void:
	position = spawn
	velocity = Vector2.ZERO
	last_floor_tick = -1000
	jump_request_tick = -1000
	opportunity_consumed = false
	require_jump_release = true
	test_jump_pressed = false
	jumps = 0
	rescued = 0
	bag_types.clear()
	jumped_this_air = false
	air_ticks = 0
	land_ticks = 0
	was_on_floor = true
	hosing = false
	bag_in_flight = 0
	play_actions([["respawn", 30]], true)  # snaps into the ready stance; any movement ends it
	queue_redraw()

func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	if not enabled:
		return
	tick += 1
	var axis := test_axis if test_control else Input.get_axis("move_left", "move_right")
	var held := test_jump_held if test_control else Input.is_action_pressed("jump")
	var pressed := test_jump_pressed if test_control else Input.is_action_just_pressed("jump")
	test_jump_pressed = false
	if not held:
		require_jump_release = false
	if is_on_floor() and velocity.y >= 0.0:
		last_floor_tick = tick
		opportunity_consumed = false
	if pressed and not require_jump_release:
		jump_request_tick = tick
	var rate: float = tuning.acceleration if not is_zero_approx(axis) else tuning.deceleration
	velocity.x = move_toward(velocity.x, axis * tuning.speed, rate * delta)
	if not is_zero_approx(axis):
		facing = signf(axis)
	velocity.y = minf(velocity.y + tuning.gravity * delta, tuning.terminal_velocity)
	if not opportunity_consumed and tick - last_floor_tick <= tuning.coyote_ticks and tick - jump_request_tick <= tuning.buffer_ticks:
		velocity.y = tuning.jump_velocity
		opportunity_consumed = true
		jump_request_tick = -1000
		jumps += 1
		jumped_this_air = true
		jumped.emit()
	move_and_slide()
	position.x = maxf(position.x, 10.0)
	_update_pose()
	queue_redraw()

func _draw() -> void:
	# The body is the generated art (sprite above). Only the rescue bag is still code-drawn:
	# the art has no bag, and rescued survivors ride in it (person or dog head per rescue).
	# Same drawing as Assignment 1, doubled, placed per pose on his back. Hidden until the
	# first rescue, so the empty bag doesn't cover the generated art.
	if bag_types.is_empty():
		return
	var f := facing                 # +1 right, -1 left
	var c: Vector2 = BAG.get(pose, BAG.idle)
	draw_set_transform(Vector2(c.x * f, c.y), 0.0, Vector2(2.0, 2.0))
	var ink := Color("1b2a3f")      # outline
	var skin := Color("e8b98f")     # face
	var bag_col := Color("e67e22")  # orange rescue duffel
	var bag_dark := Color("b8621b") # bag seam
	draw_rect(Rect2(-4.5, -4.5, 9, 9), ink)
	draw_rect(Rect2(-3.5, -3.5, 7, 7), bag_col)
	draw_rect(Rect2(-3.5, -3.5, 7, 2), bag_dark)
	# rescued survivors ride in the bag — a clear head per rescue (grows as you save more)
	for i in range(bag_types.size() - bag_in_flight):
		var hx := (-1.0 + float(i) * 4.5) * f
		var hyy := -7.0
		if String(bag_types[i]) == "dog":
			draw_colored_polygon(PackedVector2Array([Vector2(hx-3, hyy-1), Vector2(hx-2, hyy-6), Vector2(hx+0.5, hyy-1)]), Color("6b4420"))  # left ear
			draw_colored_polygon(PackedVector2Array([Vector2(hx+0.5, hyy-1), Vector2(hx+2, hyy-6), Vector2(hx+3, hyy-1)]), Color("6b4420"))  # right ear
			draw_circle(Vector2(hx, hyy), 3.2, Color("8a5a2b"))       # dog head
			draw_circle(Vector2(hx + 1.2 * f, hyy + 0.5), 0.9, ink)  # snout/eye
		else:
			draw_circle(Vector2(hx, hyy), 3.2, skin)                 # person head
			draw_rect(Rect2(hx - 3.0, hyy - 3.6, 6.0, 2.2), Color("3a2f1a"))  # hair
			draw_circle(Vector2(hx + 1.2 * f, hyy), 0.8, ink)        # eye

# Hose glow driver (CHANGE-BRIEF A2/A3, Revision 3). Presentation only: it reads player.hosing
# and writes one shader parameter on player.sprite. It never writes game state.

const SHADER := preload("res://shaders/hose_glow.gdshader")  # hand-written; not edited here
const PARAM := "glow"
const RAMP_SECONDS := 0.25   # R3: the ramps move at 1/RAMP_SECONDS per game second (0 -> 1 in 0.25 s)
const BREATH_CENTRE := 0.6   # Revision 3: while hosing, glow breathes 0.4..0.8 ...
const BREATH_AMPLITUDE := 0.2
const BREATH_PERIOD := 1.0   # ... with a 1.0 s period, in game seconds
var glow := 0.0
var hose_time := 0.0         # game seconds since hosing began (driver clock, not the shader's TIME)
var material: ShaderMaterial

func _ready() -> void:
	name = "HoseGlow"
	# One material per player instance (R8), on the sprite only (F5): the code-drawn rescue
	# bag and survivor heads are drawn on the body, not on the sprite, so they keep their colours.
	material = ShaderMaterial.new()
	material.shader = SHADER
	get_parent().sprite.material = material
	material.set_shader_parameter(PARAM, glow)

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	# _process runs after this frame's physics ticks, so it sees the session's fresh `hosing`.
	# delta is scaled game time (R4, R6): the ramps and the breathing run on it at any frame rate.
	# move_toward from the current value: a state change mid-ramp reverses from where it is (R7).
	var target := 0.0
	if get_parent().hosing:
		# t = 0 on the first frame hosing is seen (target 0.6), then accumulates per frame.
		target = BREATH_CENTRE + BREATH_AMPLITUDE * sin(TAU * hose_time / BREATH_PERIOD)
		hose_time += delta
	else:
		hose_time = 0.0
	glow = move_toward(glow, target, delta / RAMP_SECONDS)
	material.set_shader_parameter(PARAM, glow)

2	# A5 hose glow (CHANGE-BRIEF Part A): the shader's interface and the driver's rules, headless.
3	# The hosing state is driven through the real game loop and synthetic key events (W, R), never
4	# by calling the driver. The uniform is read every frame by a Sampler node whose process_priority
5	# is high, so it runs after every other _process in the frame (the driver included).
6	# Run at 30, 60 and 144 fps: scripts/run-test.sh test_hose_glow.gd <fps>.
7	# Revision 3: the hold is a breathing band 0.4..0.8 with a 1.0 s period instead of a flat 1.0;
8	# the hold assertions (in-band, maxima, period) and the ramp targets follow it.
9	# What this cannot see: pixels. Headless Godot draws nothing (CLAUDE.md, Headless facts).
10	const Game = preload("res://game/session.gd")
11	const SHADER_PATH := "res://shaders/hose_glow.gdshader"
12	const DRIVER_PATH := "res://features/player/hose_glow.gd"
13	const RAMP := 0.25     # R3: ramp rate is 1/RAMP per game second
14	const BAND_LO := 0.4   # Revision 3: while hosing, glow breathes 0.6 + 0.2 sin(2π t) ...
15	const BAND_HI := 0.8
16	const PERIOD := 1.0    # ... with a 1.0 s period in game seconds
17	const EPS := 1e-5
18	const BAND_EPS := 1e-4   # membership tolerance for the band
19	const REACH_EPS := 0.01  # how close the sampled signal must come to 0.4 and 0.8 (sampling at 30 fps loses < 0.002)
20	var game: Node2D
21	var sampler: Sampler
22	var results: Array[Dictionary] = []
23	var failures := 0
24	
25	# Records {g: glow uniform, d: process delta, h: player.hosing} once per _process frame, after
26	# everyone else's _process (priority 100). It only reads; it never touches the driver.
27	class Sampler extends Node:
28		var game: Node2D
29		var samples: Array = []
30		func _process(delta: float) -> void:
31			if not is_instance_valid(game) or game.player == null or game.player.sprite == null:
32				return

# A5 hose glow (CHANGE-BRIEF Part A): the shader's interface and the driver's rules, headless.
# The hosing state is driven through the real game loop and synthetic key events (W, R), never
# by calling the driver. The uniform is read every frame by a Sampler node whose process_priority
# is high, so it runs after every other _process in the frame (the driver included).
# Run at 30, 60 and 144 fps: scripts/run-test.sh test_hose_glow.gd <fps>.
# Revision 3: the hold is a breathing band 0.4..0.8 with a 1.0 s period instead of a flat 1.0;
# the hold assertions (in-band, maxima, period) and the ramp targets follow it.
# What this cannot see: pixels. Headless Godot draws nothing (CLAUDE.md, Headless facts).
const Game = preload("res://game/session.gd")
const SHADER_PATH := "res://shaders/hose_glow.gdshader"
const DRIVER_PATH := "res://features/player/hose_glow.gd"
const RAMP := 0.25     # R3: ramp rate is 1/RAMP per game second
const BAND_LO := 0.4   # Revision 3: while hosing, glow breathes 0.6 + 0.2 sin(2π t) ...
const BAND_HI := 0.8
const PERIOD := 1.0    # ... with a 1.0 s period in game seconds
const EPS := 1e-5
const BAND_EPS := 1e-4   # membership tolerance for the band
const REACH_EPS := 0.01  # how close the sampled signal must come to 0.4 and 0.8 (sampling at 30 fps loses < 0.002)
var game: Node2D
var sampler: Sampler
var results: Array[Dictionary] = []
var failures := 0

# Records {g: glow uniform, d: process delta, h: player.hosing} once per _process frame, after
# everyone else's _process (priority 100). It only reads; it never touches the driver.
class Sampler extends Node:
	var game: Node2D
	var samples: Array = []
	func _process(delta: float) -> void:
		if not is_instance_valid(game) or game.player == null or game.player.sprite == null:
			return
		var mat: Material = game.player.sprite.material
		var g: float = float(mat.get_shader_parameter("glow")) if mat is ShaderMaterial else -1.0
		samples.append({"g": g, "d": delta, "h": game.player.hosing})

func _initialize() -> void:
	call_deferred("run")

func steps(n: int) -> void:
	for i in range(n):
		await physics_frame
		await process_frame

# Synthetic key event through Godot Input, the path test_keyboard.gd already proves reaches
# Input.is_action_just_pressed in physics (W) and _unhandled_input (R) headlessly.
func key(code: Key, pressed: bool) -> void:
	var event := InputEventKey.new()
	event.keycode = code
	event.physical_keycode = code
	event.pressed = pressed
	Input.parse_input_event(event)

func check(id: String, condition: bool, observed: Dictionary) -> void:
	results.append({"id": id, "status": "PASS" if condition else "FAIL", "observed": observed})
	print(JSON.stringify(results.back()))
	if not condition:
		failures += 1

func fresh() -> void:
	if is_instance_valid(game):
		game.queue_free()
		await process_frame
	game = Game.new()
	game.test_mode = true
	root.add_child(game)
	game.start_session()          # real input: player.test_control stays false
	sampler.game = game
	sampler.samples.clear()
	game.player.position = Vector2(1220, 240)  # on B1-PW, in hose range (same spot as test_game.gd)
	await steps(3)

func S() -> Array:
	return sampler.samples

func in_band(g: float) -> bool:
	return g >= BAND_LO - BAND_EPS and g <= BAND_HI + BAND_EPS

func zero(g: float) -> bool:
	return is_zero_approx(g)

func first_from(from: int, pred: Callable) -> int:
	for i in range(from, S().size()):
		if pred.call(S()[i]):
			return i
	return -1

func last_before(limit: int, pred: Callable) -> int:
	var found := -1
	for i in range(0, limit):
		if pred.call(S()[i]):
			found = i
	return found

# Every step between a and b (inclusive) moves in `dir` (+1 up, -1 down), never backwards,
# and by at most delta / RAMP (+ EPS). Returns {ok, worst_step}.
func monotone(a: int, b: int, dir: float) -> Dictionary:
	var ok := a >= 0 and b > a
	var worst := 0.0
	for i in range(a + 1, b + 1):
		var step: float = (S()[i].g - S()[i - 1].g) * dir
		var max_step: float = S()[i].d / RAMP + EPS
		worst = maxf(worst, step)
		if step < -EPS or step > max_step:
			ok = false
	return {"ok": ok, "worst_step": worst}

func all_in_band(a: int, b: int) -> bool:
	if a < 0 or b < a:
		return false
	for i in range(a, b + 1):
		if not in_band(S()[i].g):
			return false
	return true

# Indices of the strict local maxima of g in [a, b] (a > 0, b < size - 1). A tie with the next
# sample counts once, on the first of the pair (at 30 fps the peak at t = 0.25 s falls between
# two samples that are equal up to rounding).
func local_maxima(a: int, b: int) -> Array[int]:
	var peaks: Array[int] = []
	for i in range(maxi(a, 1), mini(b, S().size() - 2) + 1):
		if S()[i].g > S()[i - 1].g and S()[i].g >= S()[i + 1].g:
			peaks.append(i)
	return peaks

func min_max(a: int, b: int) -> Dictionary:
	var lo := INF
	var hi := -INF
	for i in range(a, b + 1):
		lo = minf(lo, S()[i].g)
		hi = maxf(hi, S()[i].g)
	return {"min": lo, "max": hi}

func run() -> void:
	sampler = Sampler.new()
	sampler.process_priority = 100
	root.add_child(sampler)

	# --- A2 / F4: the shader's interface, from the engine and from the source text ---
	var shader: Shader = load(SHADER_PATH)
	var uniforms: Array = shader.get_shader_uniform_list()
	var types := {}
	var raw: Array = []
	for u in uniforms:
		types[String(u.name)] = int(u.type)
		raw.append({"name": String(u.name), "type": int(u.type), "hint": int(u.hint), "hint_string": String(u.hint_string)})
	check("shader-uniforms", uniforms.size() == 2 and types.get("glow", -1) == TYPE_FLOAT and types.get("glow_color", -1) == TYPE_COLOR,
		{"uniforms": raw, "TYPE_FLOAT": TYPE_FLOAT, "TYPE_COLOR": TYPE_COLOR})
	var src: String = FileAccess.get_file_as_string(SHADER_PATH)
	var re_glow := RegEx.create_from_string("uniform\\s+float\\s+glow\\s*:\\s*hint_range\\(\\s*0\\.0\\s*,\\s*1\\.0\\s*\\)\\s*=\\s*0\\.0\\s*;")
	var re_color := RegEx.create_from_string("uniform\\s+vec4\\s+glow_color\\s*:\\s*source_color\\s*=\\s*vec4\\(\\s*0\\.6\\s*,\\s*0\\.85\\s*,\\s*1\\.0\\s*,\\s*1\\.0\\s*\\)\\s*;")
	check("shader-defaults", re_glow.search(src) != null and re_color.search(src) != null,
		{"glow_default_line": re_glow.search(src) != null, "glow_color_default_line": re_color.search(src) != null, "source_bytes": src.length()})
	var re_line := RegEx.create_from_string("COLOR\\.rgb\\s*=\\s*mix\\(\\s*COLOR\\.rgb\\s*,\\s*glow_color\\.rgb\\s*,\\s*glow\\s*\\)\\s*;")
	check("colour-line", re_line.search(src) != null, {"a2_colour_line_present": re_line.search(src) != null})
	var driver_param: String = load(DRIVER_PATH).PARAM
	check("driver-param-declared", types.has(driver_param), {"driver_writes": driver_param, "shader_declares": types.keys()})

	# --- A2 / F5 / R8: where the material sits ---
	await fresh()
	var mat: Material = game.player.sprite.material
	var mat_shader_path: String = mat.shader.resource_path if mat is ShaderMaterial and mat.shader else ""
	check("material-on-sprite", mat is ShaderMaterial and mat_shader_path == SHADER_PATH and game.player.material == null and game.player.art.material == null,
		{"sprite_material": str(mat), "shader": mat_shader_path, "player_material": str(game.player.material), "art_material": str(game.player.art.material)})

	# --- R1: nothing glows before W ---
	var pre_n := S().size()
	var pre_ok := pre_n >= 3
	for i in range(pre_n):
		if S()[i].g != 0.0 or S()[i].h:
			pre_ok = false
	check("glow-starts-zero", pre_ok, {"frames": pre_n, "last": S()[pre_n - 1] if pre_n > 0 else null})

	# --- R1, R3, R4, F1 (Revision 3): W through the game loop; ramp from 0 into the band ---
	# The brief says "into the band within 0.25 s". At the ramp rate 1/RAMP the band's low edge
	# (0.4) is reached in 0.4 × 0.25 = 0.1 s, asserted to one frame as well, so a slower ramp (F1)
	# is still caught on the way up now that 1.0 is no longer the target.
	var press_at := S().size()
	key(KEY_W, true)
	await steps(2)
	key(KEY_W, false)
	var guard := 0
	while guard < 200 and first_from(press_at, func(s): return in_band(s.g)) < 0:
		await steps(1)
		guard += 1
	var i_rise := first_from(press_at, func(s): return s.g > 0.0)
	var i0 := last_before(i_rise, func(s): return s.g == 0.0) if i_rise > 0 else -1
	var i1 := first_from(press_at, func(s): return in_band(s.g))
	var d: float = S()[i1].d if i1 >= 0 else 0.0
	var up_frames := i1 - i0
	var up_time := up_frames * d
	var up_expected := BAND_LO * RAMP
	var g_max := 0.0
	for s in S():
		g_max = maxf(g_max, s.g)
	check("ramp-up-time", i0 >= 0 and i1 > i0 and up_time <= RAMP + d + EPS and absf(up_time - up_expected) <= d + EPS and g_max <= BAND_HI + BAND_EPS and S()[i_rise].h,
		{"delta": d, "fps_from_delta": 1.0 / d if d > 0.0 else 0.0, "frames": up_frames, "seconds": up_time, "within": RAMP, "expected_at_ramp_rate": up_expected, "tolerance": d, "max_glow": g_max, "hosing_at_first_rise": S()[i_rise].h if i_rise >= 0 else null})
	var up := monotone(i0, i1, 1.0)
	check("ramp-up-monotonic", up.ok, {"from": i0, "to": i1, "worst_step": up.worst_step, "max_step": d / RAMP})

	# --- R5, F2: a second W during the glow changes nothing ---
	var ticks_before: int = game.water_ticks
	var ext_before: int = game.extinguish_ticks
	var near: bool = game.near_fire
	var retrig_at := S().size()
	key(KEY_W, true)
	await steps(2)
	key(KEY_W, false)
	await steps(1)
	check("retrigger-ignored", near and ext_before > 0 and game.water_ticks < ticks_before and game.sfx_counts.hose == 1 and all_in_band(retrig_at, S().size() - 1),
		{"near_fire": near, "water_ticks_before": ticks_before, "water_ticks_after": game.water_ticks, "hose_sounds": game.sfx_counts.hose, "samples_since": S().size() - retrig_at})

	# --- R6 (Revision 2, band per Revision 3): the game's pause during the hold ---
	# The game pause freezes water_ticks (the hold) but leaves player.hosing true and does not pause
	# the tree, so the driver, which reads only player.hosing, keeps breathing inside the band. The
	# check asserts the band; min/max over the paused frames are recorded so the log shows whether
	# the value moved. A value frozen outright needs a tree pause (R6), which this test does not do.
	game.set_paused(true)
	var pause_at := S().size()
	var ticks_paused: int = game.water_ticks
	await steps(10)
	var paused_mm := min_max(pause_at, S().size() - 1)
	check("pause-holds", game.state == Game.State.PAUSED and game.water_ticks == ticks_paused and S().size() - pause_at >= 10 and all_in_band(pause_at, S().size() - 1),
		{"state": game.state, "water_ticks": game.water_ticks, "frames_paused": S().size() - pause_at, "glow_min_while_paused": paused_mm.min, "glow_max_while_paused": paused_mm.max, "glow_moved_while_paused": paused_mm.max - paused_mm.min > BAND_EPS})
	game.set_paused(false)

	# --- R1/R3 hold (Revision 3): after the first 0.25 s every hosing sample is in [0.4, 0.8] ---
	guard = 0
	while guard < 2000 and (game.player.hosing or not zero(S().back().g)):
		await steps(1)
		guard += 1
	var i_h := first_from(press_at, func(s): return s.h)         # hosing began (t = 0)
	var j0 := last_before(S().size(), func(s): return s.h)        # last hosing sample
	var band_from := i_h + ceili(RAMP / d - EPS)                  # first sample at t >= 0.25 s
	var hold_mm := min_max(band_from, j0)
	check("hold-in-band", i_h >= 0 and j0 > band_from and all_in_band(band_from, j0),
		{"hosing_from": i_h, "band_from": band_from, "last_hosing": j0, "hold_frames": j0 - i_h + 1, "hold_seconds": (j0 - i_h + 1) * d, "min": hold_mm.min, "max": hold_mm.max, "band": [BAND_LO, BAND_HI], "band_eps": BAND_EPS})

	# --- the signal breathes: at least 4 local maxima in the hold, reaching both ends of the band ---
	var peaks := local_maxima(i_h + 1, j0 - 1)
	var peak_values: Array = []
	for p in peaks:
		peak_values.append(S()[p].g)
	check("hold-breathes", peaks.size() >= 4 and hold_mm.max >= BAND_HI - REACH_EPS and hold_mm.min <= BAND_LO + REACH_EPS,
		{"maxima": peaks.size(), "maxima_at": peaks, "maxima_values": peak_values, "min": hold_mm.min, "max": hold_mm.max, "reach_eps": REACH_EPS})

	# --- period 1.0 s, peak to peak, within one frame period at this frame rate ---
	var gaps_s: Array = []
	var period_ok := peaks.size() >= 2
	var worst_gap := 0.0
	for k in range(1, peaks.size()):
		var gap_s: float = (peaks[k] - peaks[k - 1]) * d
		gaps_s.append(gap_s)
		worst_gap = maxf(worst_gap, absf(gap_s - PERIOD))
		if absf(gap_s - PERIOD) > d + EPS:
			period_ok = false
	check("hold-period", period_ok, {"peak_to_peak_seconds": gaps_s, "expected": PERIOD, "tolerance": d, "worst_error": worst_gap})

	# --- R2, R3: the hold is the game's; the down-ramp starts the frame hosing ends ---
	# From a band value g the ramp at rate 1/RAMP takes g × 0.25 s (≤ 0.25 s), asserted to one frame.
	var j1 := first_from(j0 + 1, func(s): return zero(s.g)) if j0 >= 0 else -1
	var down_frames := j1 - j0
	var down_time := down_frames * d
	var g_at_end: float = S()[j0].g if j0 >= 0 else -1.0
	var down_expected := g_at_end * RAMP
	var hold_ok: bool = j0 >= 0 and j0 + 1 < S().size() and in_band(g_at_end) and S()[j0].h and not S()[j0 + 1].h
	var down := monotone(j0, j1, -1.0)
	check("hold-is-game-time", hold_ok and j1 > j0 and absf(down_time - down_expected) <= d + EPS and down_time <= RAMP + d + EPS and zero(S().back().g) and down.ok,
		{"hold_frames": j0 - i_h + 1, "hold_seconds": (j0 - i_h + 1) * d, "glow_at_last_hosing": g_at_end, "hosing_at_last": S()[j0].h, "hosing_next_frame": S()[j0 + 1].h, "down_frames": down_frames, "down_seconds": down_time, "expected": down_expected, "tolerance": d, "monotone": down.ok, "worst_step": down.worst_step, "last": S().back().g, "water_ticks": game.water_ticks})

	# --- R7: R mid-ramp; glow descends from where it is, never jumps ---
	await fresh()
	key(KEY_W, true)
	var r_at := -1
	guard = 0
	while guard < 100 and r_at < 0:
		await steps(1)
		guard += 1
		var g: float = S().back().g
		if g > 0.3 and g < 0.7:
			key(KEY_R, true)
			r_at = S().size() - 1   # the sample on screen when R was posted
	await steps(2)
	key(KEY_R, false)
	key(KEY_W, false)
	guard = 0
	while guard < 100 and not zero(S().back().g):
		await steps(1)
		guard += 1
	var peak_idx := r_at
	for i in range(r_at, S().size()):
		if S()[i].g > S()[peak_idx].g:
			peak_idx = i
	var peak: float = S()[peak_idx].g if r_at >= 0 else -1.0
	var k1 := first_from(peak_idx + 1, func(s): return zero(s.g)) if r_at >= 0 else -1
	var dn := monotone(peak_idx, k1, -1.0)
	var restarted: bool = game.state == Game.State.PLAYING and game.water_ticks == 0 and game.player.position.distance_to(Vector2(64, 320)) < 1.0
	check("restart-mid-ramp", r_at >= 0 and peak <= BAND_HI + BAND_EPS and peak > 0.3 and peak_idx - r_at <= 2 and k1 > peak_idx and dn.ok and (k1 - peak_idx) * d <= RAMP + d + EPS and restarted,
		{"glow_at_R": S()[r_at].g if r_at >= 0 else null, "peak": peak, "frames_until_descent": peak_idx - r_at, "down_frames": k1 - peak_idx, "down_seconds": (k1 - peak_idx) * d, "monotone": dn.ok, "worst_step": dn.worst_step, "restarted": restarted, "state": game.state, "water_ticks": game.water_ticks})

	print("HOSE GLOW TESTS: %d checks / %d failures (process delta %.6f s)" % [results.size(), failures, d])
	game.queue_free()
	await process_frame
	quit(1 if failures else 0)

2	# A6 Effect A, jump puff (CHANGE-BRIEF A4, Revision 1 A-R8, Revision 2): the driver's rules, headless.
3	# Revision 2: the puff comes from player.landed (on the floor after more than 10 ticks in the air), not
4	# from the jump. Every landing comes out of the real game loop (res://game/main.tscn), driven by real
5	# keys through Godot Input: Space, D, A, R and Esc, plus Enter to start or resume and M for the menu.
6	# The test never emits `landed`, never calls the driver and never moves the player. It only watches:
7	# SceneTree.node_added for a JumpPuff added anywhere in the tree, each emitter's `finished`, each puff's
8	# tree_exited, and its own connections to player.jumped and player.landed, which record the tick, his
9	# feet and his air ticks at every emit.
10	# Two things the test does that a player can't: it enters COMPLETE through the session's own
11	# resolve_contacts(false, true) while he is in the air (the real route needs both rescues), and it sets
12	# the tree pause (the game never does).
13	# Not tested: a landing after 10 ticks or fewer in the air. Real keys can't make one on first_steps.json;
14	# its lowest drop, the 16 px step, takes 11 ticks (walk-off-landing reports the count).
15	# Run: scripts/run-test.sh test_jump_puff_state.gd 60
16	# What this cannot see: pixels or particle positions. Headless Godot draws nothing (CLAUDE.md,
17	# Headless facts); the look, the draw order on screen and the frozen frame are eye checks.
18	const Main = preload("res://game/main.tscn")
19	const Game = preload("res://game/session.gd")
20	const PUFF_PATH := "res://effects/jump_puff.tscn"
21	const KIDS := ["Flash:CPUParticles2D", "Puff:CPUParticles2D", "Specks:CPUParticles2D"]
22	const LIFE := 0.9      # A-R5: freed within 0.9 s (+ one frame) of its landing; the Puff layer's lifetime
23	const SHORTEST := 0.72 # the Puff layer's shortest possible life: lifetime 0.9 x (1 - lifetime_randomness 0.2) (A3)
24	const EPS := 1e-6
25	const SPAWN := Vector2(64, 320)
26	const GROUND_Y := 320.0  # top of the street ground (first_steps.json [0, 320, 448, 64])
27	const STEP_TOP := 304.0  # top of the 16 px step at x 160-208 (first_steps.json [160, 304, 48, 16])
28	const FEET_EPS := 0.5    # his feet rest this close above a floor's top (the body's safe margin)

31	var failures := 0

35	var landings: Array = []  # per player.landed, in order: {tick, pos, state, air_ticks, on_floor, live_after}

51	# One frame, then one look at every live puff (after this frame's physics, before its _process).
52	func steps(n: int) -> void:
53		for i in range(n):
54			await physics_frame
55			await process_frame

58	# Synthetic key event through Godot Input, as test_keyboard.gd and test_hose_glow.gd.

60		var event := InputEventKey.new()
61		event.keycode = code
62		event.physical_keycode = code
63		event.pressed = pressed

66	func tap(code: Key) -> void:
67		key(code, true)
68		await steps(2)
69		key(code, false)
70		await steps(1)

72	func wait_for(cond: Callable, limit: int) -> bool:
73		var n := 0
74		while n < limit and not cond.call():
75			await steps(1)
76			n += 1
77		return cond.call()

79	# One real jump: Space down until the jump is seen (at most 10 frames), then up.
80	func jump() -> bool:
81		var n := jumps.size()
82		key(KEY_SPACE, true)
83		await wait_for(func(): return jumps.size() > n, 10)
84		key(KEY_SPACE, false)
85		await steps(1)
86		return jumps.size() == n + 1

88	# Space as he falls the last 12 px to where he jumped from: inside the 6-tick jump buffer, so the
89	# next jump starts on the tick after the landing (CHANGE-BRIEF "Jump timing").
90	func jump_on_landing() -> bool:
91		var from_y: float = jumps.back().pos.y
92		await wait_for(func(): return game.player.velocity.y > 0.0 and game.player.position.y >= from_y - 12.0, 90)
93		return await jump()

95	# Onto the 16 px step with real keys, from the ground to its left: D held, Space at x 110, D let go at
96	# x 176, so he comes down on the step's top. True if that landing was on the step.
97	func onto_step() -> bool:
98		var n := landings.size()
99		key(KEY_D, true)
100		await wait_for(func(): return game.player.position.x >= 110.0, 90)
101		var ok: bool = await jump()
102		await wait_for(func(): return game.player.position.x >= 176.0, 60)
103		key(KEY_D, false)
104		await wait_for(func(): return landings.size() > n, 90)
105		return ok and landings.size() == n + 1 and absf(landings.back().pos.y - STEP_TOP) < FEET_EPS

107	# In the air above the street ground (where every mid-air check below happens).

119	func _on_node_added(node: Node) -> void:
120		if node.scene_file_path != PUFF_PATH:
121			return
122		var rec := {"node": node, "id": node.get_instance_id(), "tick": tick(), "pos": node.global_position,
123			"parent": node.get_parent(), "kids": [], "emitting": [], "finished": {}, "freed_tick": -1,
124			"freed_state": -1, "samples": 0, "moved": 0, "max_dist": 0.0}
125		for c in node.get_children():
126			rec.kids.append("%s:%s" % [c.name, c.get_class()])
127			rec.emitting.append(c.emitting)
128			c.finished.connect(_on_emitter_finished.bind(rec, String(c.name)))
129		node.tree_exited.connect(_on_puff_exited.bind(rec))
130		puffs.append(rec)

132	func _on_emitter_finished(rec: Dictionary, emitter: String) -> void:
133		rec.finished[emitter] = tick()
134	
135	func _on_puff_exited(rec: Dictionary) -> void:
136		rec.freed_tick = tick()
137		rec.freed_state = game.state if is_instance_valid(game) else -1

139	func _on_jumped() -> void:
140		jumps.append({"tick": tick(), "pos": game.player.global_position, "state": game.state})
141	
142	# Runs inside the emit, before _update_pose() zeroes air_ticks, so air_ticks is his time in the air.
143	func _on_landed() -> void:
144		var p: CharacterBody2D = game.player
145		landings.append({"tick": tick(), "pos": p.global_position, "state": game.state, "air_ticks": p.air_ticks,
146			"on_floor": p.is_on_floor(), "live_after": -1})

148	func live() -> Array:
149		return puffs.filter(func(r): return r.freed_tick < 0)
150	
151	func sample() -> void:
152		if not is_instance_valid(game):
153			return
154		var alive := live()
155		max_live = maxi(max_live, alive.size())
156		if seen_landings < landings.size():
157			landings.back().live_after = alive.size()   # puffs alive at the end of the landing's physics tick
158			seen_landings = landings.size()
159		var player_index: int = game.player.get_index()
160		for rec in alive:
161			var node: Node2D = rec.node
162			looked += 1
163			rec.samples += 1
164			rec.max_dist = maxf(rec.max_dist, node.global_position.distance_to(game.player.global_position))
165			if node.global_position != rec.pos:
166				moved += 1
167				rec.moved += 1
168			if node.get_parent() != game:
169				wrong_parent += 1
170			if node.get_index() >= player_index:
171				in_front += 1
172	
173	func puffs_in_tree() -> int:
174		var n := 0
175		for node in root.find_children("*", "", true, false):
176			if node.scene_file_path == PUFF_PATH:
177				n += 1
178		return n

180	# Puffs added in physics ticks [from, to).
181	func puffs_between(from: int, to: int) -> int:
182		return puffs.filter(func(r): return r.tick >= from and r.tick < to).size()
183	
184	# Seconds of unpaused game time from its landing to its free (tree pauses the test made are taken out).
185	func life(rec: Dictionary) -> float:
186		var ticks: int = rec.freed_tick - rec.tick
187		for p in tree_pauses:
188			ticks -= maxi(0, mini(rec.freed_tick, p[1]) - maxi(rec.tick, p[0]))
189		return ticks * tick_s
190	
191	# A-R5: within LIFE plus one frame; and not before SHORTEST minus one frame. Not LIFE minus one frame:
192	# with lifetime_randomness the last Puff particle can die early (unseeded puffs, no game: 1 in 400
193	# finished 3 frames early).
194	func on_time(rec: Dictionary) -> bool:
195		var l := life(rec)
196		return rec.freed_tick >= 0 and l <= LIFE + frame_s + EPS and l >= SHORTEST - frame_s - EPS
197	
198	# A-R5: all three emitters finished, and the puff was freed in the frame the last one did.
199	func all_finished(rec: Dictionary) -> bool:
200		if rec.finished.size() != KIDS.size():
201			return false
202		var last := -1
203		for t in rec.finished.values():
204			last = maxi(last, t)
205		return rec.freed_tick == last
206	
207	# A-R3 "full puff": the scene's three emitters, all emitting when it was added.
208	func full(rec: Dictionary) -> bool:
209		return rec.kids == KIDS and rec.emitting == [true, true, true]
210	
211	# Revision 2 A-R1: the puff is the one added in the landing's tick, at his feet then, on the floor at
212	# floor_y, in PLAYING, after more than 10 ticks in the air.
213	func at_feet(l: Dictionary, p: Dictionary, floor_y: float) -> bool:
214		return p.tick == l.tick and p.pos == l.pos and l.state == Game.State.PLAYING and l.on_floor and absf(l.pos.y - floor_y) < FEET_EPS and l.air_ticks > 10
215	
216	func landing_info(l: Dictionary, p: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
217		return {"landing_tick": l.tick, "puff_tick": p.tick, "player_at_landing": str(l.pos), "puff_at": str(p.pos),
218			"on_floor": l.on_floor, "air_ticks": l.air_ticks, "state_at_landing": l.state}
219	
220	func timings(rec: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
221		var out := {}
222		for k in rec.finished:
223			out[k] = snappedf((rec.finished[k] - rec.tick) * tick_s, 0.0001)
224		return {"finished_after_s": out, "freed_after_s": snappedf(life(rec), 0.0001), "freed_with_last_finished": all_finished(rec)}
225	
226	func counts() -> Dictionary:
227		return {"state": game.state, "jumped": jumps.size(), "landed": landings.size(), "puffs_added": puffs.size(), "puffs_in_tree": puffs_in_tree()}
228	
229	func mark() -> Array:
230		return [jumps.size(), landings.size(), puffs.size()]
231	
232	func same(m: Array) -> bool:
233		return jumps.size() == m[0] and landings.size() == m[1] and puffs.size() == m[2]

235	func run() -> void:
236		node_added.connect(_on_node_added)
237		tick_s = 1.0 / Engine.physics_ticks_per_second
238		game = Main.instantiate()
239		game.test_mode = true
240		root.add_child(game)
241		game.player.jumped.connect(_on_jumped)
242		game.player.landed.connect(_on_landed)
243		await steps(30)
244		frame_s = root.get_process_delta_time()
245	
246		# --- A-R2: nothing on scene load, in MENU, or on start (the start respawns him) ---
247		check("none-on-load", game.state == Game.State.MENU and puffs.is_empty() and landings.is_empty() and puffs_in_tree() == 0, counts())
248		await tap(KEY_SPACE)
249		await steps(10)
250		check("none-in-menu", game.state == Game.State.MENU and puffs.is_empty() and jumps.is_empty() and landings.is_empty(), counts())
251		await tap(KEY_ENTER)
252		await steps(10)
253		check("none-on-start", game.state == Game.State.PLAYING and game.player.is_on_floor() and puffs.is_empty() and jumps.is_empty() and landings.is_empty(), counts())
254	
255		# --- Revision 2 A-R1/A-R2, A-R4, A-R5, A-R6: one real jump with D held for 12 frames, so he comes down
256		# away from where he took off: nothing on the jump, one puff on the landing; then A walks him away ---
257		key(KEY_D, true)
258		var jumped: bool = await jump()
259		var at_jump := puffs.size()
260		await steps(12)
261		key(KEY_D, false)
262		var landed: bool = await wait_for(func(): return landings.size() > 0, 90)
263		key(KEY_A, true)
264		await steps(30)
265		key(KEY_A, false)
266		await wait_for(func(): return live().is_empty(), 90)
267		if not jumped or not landed or jumps.size() != 1 or landings.size() != 1 or puffs.size() != 1:
268			check("none-on-jump", false, counts())
269			return finish()
270		var j: Dictionary = jumps[0]
271		var l: Dictionary = landings[0]
272		var p: Dictionary = puffs[0]
273		check("none-on-jump", at_jump == 0 and puffs_between(j.tick, l.tick) == 0 and p.tick == l.tick and p.tick != j.tick,
274			{"jump_tick": j.tick, "puffs_after_jump_frame": at_jump, "puffs_while_in_air": puffs_between(j.tick, l.tick), "landing_tick": l.tick, "puff_tick": p.tick})
275		var info := landing_info(l, p)
276		info.merge({"player_at_jump": str(j.pos), "takeoff_to_puff_px": snappedf(j.pos.distance_to(p.pos), 0.01)})
277		check("one-puff-at-landing", at_feet(l, p, GROUND_Y) and j.pos.distance_to(p.pos) >= 15.0, info)
278		check("parent-is-level", p.parent == game and p.parent != game.player and full(p),
279			{"parent": str(p.parent.name) if is_instance_valid(p.parent) else "", "children": p.kids, "emitting_when_added": p.emitting})
280		check("stays-put", p.samples > 0 and p.moved == 0 and p.max_dist >= 30.0,
281			{"frames_sampled": p.samples, "frames_moved": p.moved, "player_max_distance_px": snappedf(p.max_dist, 0.01), "puff_at": str(p.pos)})
282		var t := timings(p)
283		t.merge({"expected_s": LIFE, "earliest_s": SHORTEST,"tolerance_s": frame_s, "puffs_in_tree": puffs_in_tree()})
284		check("frees-when-finished", all_finished(p) and on_time(p) and puffs_in_tree() == 0, t)
285	
286		# --- A-R3 overlap: four jumps, each Space just before he lands, so each jump starts on the tick after
287		# a landing and the next landing comes 0.8 s later on flat ground, inside one 0.9 s puff life ---
288		await steps(10)
289		max_live = 0
290		var i1 := landings.size()
291		var chain_ok: bool = await jump()
292		for k in range(3):
293			if not await jump_on_landing():
294				chain_ok = false
295		await wait_for(func(): return landings.size() >= i1 + 4, 90)
296		await wait_for(func(): return live().is_empty(), 90)
297		if not chain_ok or landings.size() != i1 + 4 or puffs.size() != i1 + 4:
298			check("retrigger-overlap", false, counts())
299			return finish()
300		var gaps: Array = []
301		for k in range(i1 + 1, i1 + 4):
302			gaps.append(snappedf((landings[k].tick - landings[k - 1].tick) * tick_s, 0.0001))
303		var l1: Dictionary = landings[i1]
304		var l2: Dictionary = landings[i1 + 1]
305		var p1: Dictionary = puffs[i1]
306		var p2: Dictionary = puffs[i1 + 1]
307		var gap: float = (l2.tick - l1.tick) * tick_s
308		check("retrigger-overlap", gap < LIFE and l2.live_after == 2 and p1.tick == l1.tick and p1.freed_tick > l2.tick and p1.finished.get("Puff", -1) > l2.tick and p2.id != p1.id and at_feet(l2, p2, GROUND_Y) and full(p2),
309			{"landing_gap_s": gap, "live_at_landing_2": l2.live_after, "first_freed_after_landing_2_s": (p1.freed_tick - l2.tick) * tick_s, "first_puff_layer_running_at_landing_2": p1.finished.get("Puff", -1) > l2.tick, "second_is_new_instance": p2.id != p1.id, "second_full": full(p2), "second_at": str(p2.pos), "player_at_landing_2": str(l2.pos)})
310		var t1 := timings(p1)
311		var t2 := timings(p2)
312		check("first-not-restarted", all_finished(p1) and on_time(p1) and all_finished(p2) and on_time(p2),
313			{"first": t1, "second": t2, "first_if_restarted_at_landing_2_s": gap + LIFE, "expected_s": LIFE, "earliest_s": SHORTEST,"tolerance_s": frame_s})
314		check("max-two-alive", max_live == 2, {"landings": 4, "landing_gaps_s": gaps, "max_live": max_live})
315	
316		# --- Revision 2 on a higher floor, A-R2 (R) and A-R6: real keys put him on the 16 px step; R 0.2 s
317		# after that landing: no puff from R or the respawn, and the step puff stays where it was made ---
318		await steps(10)
319		var on_step: bool = await onto_step()
320		var sl: Dictionary = landings.back()
321		var sp: Dictionary = puffs.back()
322		check("one-puff-on-step", on_step and at_feet(sl, sp, STEP_TOP), landing_info(sl, sp))
323		await wait_for(func(): return tick() - sp.tick >= 12, 30)
324		var m := mark()
325		await tap(KEY_R)
326		await steps(10)
327		var at_spawn: bool = game.player.position.distance_to(SPAWN) < 1.0
328		var c := counts()
329		c.merge({"player_at": str(game.player.position)})
330		check("none-on-restart", game.state == Game.State.PLAYING and at_spawn and game.player.is_on_floor() and same(m), c)
331		var after_r: bool = sp.freed_tick < 0 and sp.node.get_parent() == game and sp.node.global_position == sp.pos
332		var apart: float = sp.pos.distance_to(game.player.global_position)
333		await wait_for(func(): return sp.freed_tick >= 0, 90)
334		t = timings(sp)
335		t.merge({"alive_in_level_after_R": after_r, "puff_at": str(sp.pos), "player_after_R": str(game.player.position), "apart_px": snappedf(apart, 0.01), "expected_s": LIFE, "earliest_s": SHORTEST,"tolerance_s": frame_s})
336		check("restart-mid-puff", after_r and apart > 50.0 and sp.moved == 0 and all_finished(sp) and on_time(sp), t)
337	
338		# --- Revision 2 A-R2: walking off the step is a landing when he is in the air more than 10 ticks; D
339		# stays held, so he walks on into the street spike fire (x 320-344): DYING. Space and A while DYING
340		# do nothing; the restart after the 2.0 s hold is a respawn, not a landing ---
341		await steps(5)
342		var on_step_2: bool = await onto_step()
343		await steps(5)
344		m = mark()
345		key(KEY_D, true)
346		var left_step: bool = await wait_for(func(): return not game.player.is_on_floor(), 60)
347		var air_from := tick()
348		var down: bool = await wait_for(func(): return game.player.is_on_floor(), 60)
349		var air_measured := tick() - air_from
350		var wl: Dictionary = landings.back()
351		var wp: Dictionary = puffs.back()
352		info = landing_info(wl, wp)
353		info.merge({"on_step_before": on_step_2, "left_step": left_step, "air_ticks_measured_by_test": air_measured, "jumped_since_on_step": jumps.size() - m[0], "landed_since_on_step": landings.size() - m[1], "puffs_since_on_step": puffs.size() - m[2]})
354		check("walk-off-landing", on_step_2 and left_step and down and jumps.size() == m[0] and landings.size() == m[1] + 1 and puffs.size() == m[2] + 1 and air_measured > 10 and wl.air_ticks == air_measured and at_feet(wl, wp, GROUND_Y), info)
355		var died: bool = await wait_for(func(): return game.state == Game.State.DYING, 90)
356		key(KEY_D, false)
357		m = mark()
358		await tap(KEY_SPACE)
359		await tap(KEY_A)
360		var still_dying: bool = game.state == Game.State.DYING
361		var back: bool = await wait_for(func(): return game.state == Game.State.PLAYING, 150)
362		var none_dying := same(m)
363		c = counts()
364		c.merge({"died": died, "death_reason": game.death_reason, "space_and_a_while_dying": still_dying, "restarted": back, "walk_off_puff_freed_in_state": wp.freed_state})
365		check("none-while-dying", died and game.death_reason == "The fire got you." and still_dying and back and none_dying, c)
366		await steps(10)
367		c = counts()
368		c.merge({"player_at": str(game.player.position)})
369		check("none-on-respawn", game.state == Game.State.PLAYING and game.player.position.distance_to(SPAWN) < 1.0 and game.player.is_on_floor() and same(m), c)

371		# --- A-R2 (R mid-air): R while he is in the air puts him back on the spawn point; that respawn is not
372		# a landing (reset_at), and the landing he was heading for never comes ---
373		await steps(5)
374		await jump()
375		await steps(15)
376		var up := airborne()
377		m = mark()
378		await tap(KEY_R)
379		await steps(60)
380		c = counts()
381		c.merge({"in_air_at_R": up, "player_at": str(game.player.position)})
382		check("none-on-restart-midair", up and game.state == Game.State.PLAYING and game.player.position.distance_to(SPAWN) < 1.0 and game.player.is_on_floor() and same(m), c)

385		# not the tree): no landing, no puff for 1 s, Space included. Enter resumes, he comes down, and that
386		# landing makes one puff; Esc again at once, and the puff finishes on time while paused ---
387		await steps(5)
388		await jump()
389		await steps(15)
390		up = airborne()
391		await tap(KEY_ESCAPE)
392		var esc_paused: bool = game.state == Game.State.PAUSED
393		m = mark()
394		await steps(60)
395		await tap(KEY_SPACE)
396		await steps(5)
397		c = counts()
398		c.merge({"in_air_at_esc": up, "still_in_air": airborne(), "player_at": str(game.player.position)})
399		check("none-while-paused", up and esc_paused and game.state == Game.State.PAUSED and airborne() and same(m), c)
400		await tap(KEY_ENTER)
401		var resumed: bool = game.state == Game.State.PLAYING
402		var came_down: bool = await wait_for(func(): return landings.size() > m[1], 90)
403		await tap(KEY_ESCAPE)
404		var paused_again: bool = game.state == Game.State.PAUSED
405		var rl: Dictionary = landings.back()
406		var pp: Dictionary = puffs.back()
407		info = landing_info(rl, pp)
408		info.merge({"resumed": resumed, "landed_since_esc": landings.size() - m[1], "puffs_since_esc": puffs.size() - m[2]})
409		check("landing-after-resume", resumed and came_down and landings.size() == m[1] + 1 and puffs.size() == m[2] + 1 and at_feet(rl, pp, GROUND_Y), info)
410		await wait_for(func(): return pp.freed_tick >= 0, 90)

# A6 Effect B frame-strip fixture (CHANGE-BRIEF B5). Not part of the game.
# It instances the real level (res://game/main.tscn) and starts a session with `test_mode` on (a
# focus loss doesn't pause it) and the player under test control (no key moves him). He stands on
# B1's roof at x 1215, facing the blocking fire and in hose range; the session puts the camera at
# x 1315 (player.x + 100, y stays 180). The HUD is hidden, as in the jump puff preview.
# Condition: on frame 10 it presses W through the player's hook (`test_water_pressed`, as
# test_game.gd does), so the session's own counters run it, and the fire shrinks and goes out as in
# play. The session counts the press tick as the first of its 240 / 300, so the press is made on
# frame 10's last physics tick: under --fixed-fps 30 (two ticks per frame) `player.hosing` is then
# first true on frame 10, the fire is out on frame 130 and `hosing` is false from frame 160.
# The steam is a HoseSteam this script adds to the level node; nothing in the game creates or drives
# one. Each frame it writes on its own instance what the brief gives the driver (B-R1 to B-R4):
# `emitting` from `player.hosing`, `amount_ratio` = fire_height() / full height, and the root at
# the top centre of the fire. It is added last, so it draws over the fire and over Extinguisho;
# the brief does not set the in-game order.
# Frame N here is the preview's N-th drawn frame, counted from 0 (file N of a Movie Maker strip).
# Capture with a window (30 fps):
#   godot --path godot --write-movie <absolute dir>/frame.png --fixed-fps 30 --quit-after 210 --always-on-top res://previews/hose_steam_preview.tscn
const HoseSteam = preload("res://effects/hose_steam.tscn")
const STAND := Vector2(1215, 240)   # B1 roof (x 1175-1365, top at y 240), left of the fire at x 1250-1306
const TRIGGER_FRAME := 10
const SEED := 1278  # preview only (CHANGE-BRIEF B3): fixed seeds on this scene's own instance
@onready var game: Node2D = $WalkerJumpman
var steam: Node2D
var emitters: Array[GPUParticles2D] = []
var fire: Array                    # level.blocking_fire: [x, y, w, h]
var frame := 0                     # frames drawn so far
var ticks_in_frame := 0            # physics ticks run so far in this frame
var ticks_per_frame := 1           # from the last frame's delta: 2 under --fixed-fps 30
var pressed := false
var was_hosing := false
var was_fire_active := true

func _ready() -> void:
	game.test_mode = true
	game.start_session()
	game.player.test_control = true
	game.player.reset_at(STAND)
	game.player.action_queue.clear()   # reset_at's 0.5 s respawn stance; in play he walks up to the fire
	game.camera.position = Vector2(STAND.x + 100.0, 180.0)
	game.hud.visible = false
	fire = game.level.blocking_fire
	steam = HoseSteam.instantiate()
	for i in steam.get_child_count():
		var emitter: GPUParticles2D = steam.get_child(i)
		emitter.use_fixed_seed = true
		emitter.seed = SEED + i
		emitters.append(emitter)
	steam.position = _fire_top()   # placed before it first emits, so nothing is released on the way from (0, 0)
	game.add_child(steam)

func _physics_process(_delta: float) -> void:
	ticks_in_frame += 1
	# `>=`, not `==`: in a live window ticks and drawn frames are not one-to-one, so the press falls
	# on the first tick that reaches the count, on frame 10 or just after.
	if not pressed and frame >= TRIGGER_FRAME and ticks_in_frame >= ticks_per_frame:
		game.player.test_water_pressed = true   # the session reads it later in this same tick
		pressed = true

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	var hosing: bool = game.player.hosing
	var height: float = game.fire_height()
	for emitter in emitters:
		if emitter.emitting != hosing:
			emitter.emitting = hosing
		emitter.amount_ratio = clampf(height / float(fire[3]), 0.0, 1.0)
	steam.position = _fire_top()
	if hosing != was_hosing:
		print("preview: hosing %s on frame %d (fire height %.2f, amount_ratio %.3f)" % [hosing, frame, height, emitters[0].amount_ratio])
		was_hosing = hosing
	if game.fire_active != was_fire_active:
		print("preview: fire out on frame %d" % frame)
		was_fire_active = game.fire_active
	frame += 1
	ticks_in_frame = 0
	ticks_per_frame = maxi(1, roundi(delta * Engine.physics_ticks_per_second))

func _fire_top() -> Vector2:
	return Vector2(float(fire[0]) + float(fire[2]) / 2.0, float(fire[1]) + float(fire[3]) - game.fire_height())

# Plan: wire Effect B (hose steam) to `player.hosing` and `fire_height()`, plus a state test

I haven't edited anything yet. The plan has three steps, each done only after you approve it.

## Step 1: the driver (one new file, two lines in `player.gd`)

**New file `godot/features/player/hose_steam_driver.gd`**, a `Node` built the same way as `hose_glow.gd` and `jump_puff_driver.gd`:

- **In `_ready()`:** it creates one `HoseSteam` and adds it to the level node (`WalkerJumpman`). That puts the root's position in level coordinates (B-R4) and means nothing that moves or gets freed owns it. It places the root at the top of the fire before adding it, so the emitter never starts from (0, 0). If the level has no `blocking_fire`, it creates nothing.
- **In `_process()`, every frame,** it reads `player.hosing`, `session.fire_height()` and `session.level.blocking_fire[3]`, which is 34. It writes in this order:
  1. the root's `position` = (1278, 240 − `fire_height()`) (B-R4)
  2. `amount_ratio` on Haze and Steam = `clampf(fire_height() / 34, 0, 1)` (B-R3)
  3. `emitting` on both = `hosing`, written only when it changes (B-R1, B-R2)

  Writing position and ratio before `emitting` means the first emitting frame already starts at the right place and strength. When it stops it only writes `emitting = false`: no `restart()`, no hiding, no freeing, so steam already in the air isn't cleared.
